title: Building the webvise Website with AI Agents and Full Transparency
excerpt: webvise.io is a production Next.js application with structured multilingual content, reviewed case studies, a Gemini-powered chat interface, and every page maintained across 7 languages.
challenge: When you build websites and software for clients, your own site can easily lag behind the way you actually work. webvise needed a site that shows the current delivery model clearly: a production application, structured multilingual content, reviewed case studies, and an AI chat interface that helps visitors understand services without adding extra sales overhead.
solution: The site is developed through an AI-native engineering workflow on Next.js. The stack includes structured JSON content, multilingual routing, reviewed blog and case-study content, and a Gemini-powered chat interface built with the Vercel AI SDK. Each language version is maintained as part of the same production app, so updates can move through the codebase, QA, and deployment together.
